*חֲרָצָא חֵרֵץ Ch. Lumbus. Plur. חֲרִיצִין Lumbi, Dan.5.6. חֲרַצִי, חֲרִיצִי Ch. Fossæ, foveæ, Jobi 38.25. & Josh.11.v.8. חֲרִיצוּתָא Formido, metus, pavor. Prov.10.24.
חרק Ch. Frendere, Stridere dentibus, Esth.3.8. in Targ.sec. Pahel [illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Idem, Marc.9.18. Act.7.54.
[illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Stridor, Frendor dentium, Matth.8.12.

חרר חר Ch. Ardere, exardere, excandescere, exuri, aduri, exarescere: Item Liberum esse vel efficere, libertate donare, in libertatem afferere. Ch.& Syr. Pahel [illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Idem. Ithpahel אִתְחָרַר, Syr. [illegible, ~3 letters] Liberari, libertate donare: & ex alia formâ, אִתְחָרְחַר, Exarescere, exsiccari. Aphel Futur. תְּחָרְרָנָה Coques placentam illam, nempe Ardore ignis, Ezech.4.12.
חַרְרָא חָרָר Ch. Toftum, Torta, Placenta.
חוֹרָא, חוֹר Chald. Foramen, caverna. Plur. חוֹרָאֵי, 1.Sam.14.11.
[illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Idem, [illegible, ~3 letters] Foramen acus, Matth.19.24.

חוּרִין Ch. [illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Liberi, ingenui, nobiles, illustres: Clari, candidi, candidati. Posset etiam referri ad חור. Hinc Lat. Herus, Germ. Herr, Fœm. sing. [illegible, ~3 letters] Libera, ad Gal.4.30.31.
